goal: Explain in under three minutes that probabilistic model proposals require deterministic policy and capability boundaries, with confidential-computing attestation as a separate resource-release guarantee.

deck_context.core_claim: Don't put guarantees inside the prompt. Put guarantees around the model.
factual_limits: PLAYBOOK.md and model proposals are untrusted.
Python PolicyEngine evaluates authoritative state and policy.
CapabilityGate controls a fixed simulated executor set.
DENY means the executor is never called.
The attack is a controlled deterministic example, not an observed live Gemini result.
Gemini inference remains remote and outside this project's TEE.
This checkout contains no current live cloud-attestation evidence.

sample_generation_method.prompt_source: approved Slide 2 architecture prompt derived from the user-approved presentation brief
sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: view_image local style and strict input assets before built-in generation
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Use the same built-in image_gen generate path; return a blocker if unavailable.

style.name: minimal editorial engineering conference
style.visual_direction: carefully hand-crafted PowerPoint with Apple-keynote clarity; flat, precise, quiet, and strongly typographic
style.color_palette: near-black #111111 and one muted amber #B7791F accent only
style.typography: clean modern sans-serif, two weights maximum, large and projector-readable
style.density: very sparse with generous whitespace and one idea per slide
style.avoid: photos, illustration, AI imagery, gradients, shadows, texture, 3D, decorative geometry, icon collections, cards, fake terminals, logos, watermarks, slide numbers

approved_style_reference.fidelity: match palette, typography, spacing, and line treatment only; do not copy layout or content

slides.title: Your AI assistant shouldn't trust you.
slides.intent: Open with one provocative thesis and no visual distraction.

layout.composition: Typography only. Large two-line title in the upper-left/middle-left, two-line support text below, tiny footer at bottom-left. Vast empty right side.

visual_elements.supporting_elements: one short muted amber rule near the support text, optional

constraints: No diagram, image, icon, logo, or decoration.
Title uses sentence case and a period.

slides.title: The model can suggest. Software decides.
slides.intent: Make the untrusted-to-enforced boundary immediately legible.
key_points: UNTRUSTED: USER / PLAYBOOK → GEMINI → TYPED PROPOSAL
ENFORCED: POLICY ENGINE → CAPABILITY GATE → FIXED EXECUTOR

layout.composition: Large two-line title on the left; a single top-to-bottom architecture on the right with thin rectangles, arrows, and one amber boundary rule.

constraints: Exact labels only; no implementation dump.

slides.title: Bad guidance can change the proposal.
slides.intent: Show the proposal changing before revealing the policy result.

layout.composition: Title at upper-left. Two large typographic states arranged left-to-right or top-to-bottom with one simple arrow: playbook quote to model proposal. Small footer at bottom-left.

visual_elements.supporting_elements: muted amber used only on the quote or arrow

constraints: Do not show ALLOW, DENY, policy, capability, or executor.
Do not imply this was observed in live Gemini.

slides.title: But the model doesn't own authority.
slides.intent: Show deterministic denial and non-execution with maximum clarity.

layout.composition: Small title at upper-left. Centered vertical flow. DENY is the largest word on the slide. The final sentence is small below the flow.

visual_elements.main_visual: minimal vertical typographic flow with two thin arrows

constraints: No lock icon; words and lines only.

slides.title: The model changed its mind. The security boundary didn't.
slides.intent: Land the takeaway and give the audience the repository.
key_points: Policy decides whether an action may happen.
Attestation decides which workload may receive protected state.
Full implementation + tests + cloud verification status
We don't need deterministic intelligence. We need deterministic boundaries around probabilistic intelligence.

required_images.role: strict input asset; repository QR code
required_images.fidelity: preserve every QR module exactly; do not redraw, stylize, crop, blur, rotate, or alter it

layout.composition: Large two-line conclusion at upper-left. Two short explanatory lines below. QR code large at right with repository URL directly beneath. Small final takeaway runs along the bottom.

visual_elements.supporting_elements: one short muted amber rule separating the bottom takeaway

constraints: The supplied QR is a strict input asset and must remain machine-readable.
No claim of successful or current cloud verification.
No icons, logos, or decorative imagery.
